confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

cloud_link.title: Link MeatNet Cloud credentials
cloud_link.description: Experimental unofficial cloud access. Enter a Firebase Web API key and refresh token obtained through an operator-controlled bootstrap. These credentials are stored in the Home Assistant config entry; Home Assistant configuration/backups are not application-level encrypted credential storage.

data_description.cloud_api_key: App-public Firebase Web API key used by the Combustion app. Do not publish it in this repository or chat transcripts.
data_description.cloud_refresh_token: Private refresh credential for your MeatNet Cloud account. Do not paste it into issues, logs, or chat.

reconfigure.title: Manage MeatNet Cloud link
reconfigure.description: Manage the optional cloud account linked to this Combustion Meatnet.

menu_options.cloud_reauth: Update credentials for the same account

cloud_reauth.title: Update MeatNet Cloud credentials
cloud_reauth.description: Enter new credentials for the same Firebase account. A different account is rejected; use Replace account instead.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate MeatNet Cloud
reauth_confirm.description: Cloud authorization failed. Enter valid credentials for the same linked Firebase account. Local Bluetooth operation remains independent.

cloud_replace.title: Replace MeatNet Cloud account
cloud_replace.description: Link a different Firebase account. This advances the account-link generation so delayed work from the old account cannot be attributed to the new one.

cloud_unlink.title: Unlink MeatNet Cloud
cloud_unlink.description: Remove locally stored cloud credentials and stop active cloud work. This does not delete vendor data or claim to revoke the credential at the provider.

abort.not_supported: This Combustion device does not broadcast usable data.
abort.already_configured: The Combustion Meatnet is already configured.
abort.no_devices_found: No Combustion devices found. Turn on a probe, gauge, booster or display within Bluetooth range and try again.
abort.cloud_not_linked: No MeatNet Cloud account is linked.

error.wrong_account: These credentials belong to a different MeatNet Cloud account.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the cloud service.
error.cloud_permission: The cloud account authenticated but access was denied.
error.cloud_unsupported: The cloud response did not match the currently qualified unofficial protocol.
error.same_account: This is the currently linked account. Use Update credentials instead.

data.availability_timeout: Seconds without advertisements before entities become unavailable
data.update_throttle: Minimum seconds between sensor updates per device
data.enable_active_connection: Active connection: predictions + control (requires a connectable Bluetooth proxy or adapter)
